abstract: Cervical teratomas are uncommon lesions usually diagnosed at birth but occasionally reported in older children and adults. During a 58-year span, nine cervical teratomas were identified at our institution (four previously reported): three stillborns with giant tumors; five live newborns; and one adult with a malignant tumor. Of the five newborns, two prematures died within one hour of birth. Of the three survivors, 2 had respiratory distress at birth. These infants were treated with early excision and are well at 7, 6, and 2 years of age. The last patient also had cystic fibrosis. The adult died of metastatic disease 8 months after resection. A literature review disclosed 212 cases in addition to the five reported here. Previous attempts at categorizing cervical teratomas have failed to address clinical patterns and have little prognostic value. We propose a classification based on birth status, age at diagnosis, and the presence or absence of respiratory distress. Group I--stillborn and moribund live newborns: number (N), 27; mortality (M), 100%. Group II--newborn with respiratory distress: N, 99; M, 43.4%. Group III--newborn without respiratory distress: N, 37; M, 2.7%. Group IV--children age 1 month to 18 years: N, 31; M, 3.2%. Group V--adults: N, 23; M, 43.5%. Twenty-six patients in group II and one in group III died without excision of the mass. Seventy-three patients in group II, 36 in group III, and 31 in group IV had extirpation of the tumor. Operative mortality was 11%, 0%, and 3.2%, respectively.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 頸部奇形腫は稀な病変で、通常は出生時に診断されるが、年長児や成人でも報告されることがある。58年間に当施設で9例の頸部奇形腫が確認された（うち4例は既報）。内訳は、巨大腫瘍を伴う死産児3例、生児5例、悪性腫瘍を伴う成人1例である。生児5例のうち2例は早産で出生後1時間以内に死亡した。生存した3例のうち2例は出生時に呼吸窮迫を認めた。これらの乳児は早期切除を受け、現在7歳、6歳、2歳で良好に経過している。最後の患者は嚢胞性線維症も合併していた。成人例は切除後8か月で転移性疾患により死亡した。文献レビューでは、本報告の5例に加えて212例が確認された。従来の頸部奇形腫の分類法は臨床的パターンを十分に扱っておらず、予後予測の価値も乏しい。出生時の状態、診断時年齢、呼吸窮迫の有無に基づく分類を提案する。第I群（死産および瀕死の生児）は27例で死亡率100%。第II群（呼吸窮迫を伴う新生児）は99例で死亡率43.4%。第III群（呼吸窮迫のない新生児）は37例で死亡率2.7%。第IV群（生後1か月から18歳までの小児）は31例で死亡率3.2%。第V群（成人）は23例で死亡率43.5%。第II群の26例と第III群の1例は腫瘤を切除せずに死亡した。第II群の73例、第III群の36例、第IV群の31例は腫瘍摘出を受けた。手術死亡率はそれぞれ11%、0%、3.2%であった。（抄録は250語で打ち切り）
